events.body:
## Context

`tests/tests_cli.py` has 10 tests, but pytest only collects `test_*.py` / `*_test.py` and there's no config overriding that, so CI never runs them (they pass when run directly).

## What to do

1. `git mv tests/tests_cli.py tests/test_cli.py`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `python -m pytest -q` output includes `tests/test_cli.py`
- [ ] Suite passes

## How to test locally

```bash
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-preflight
```
